description: This file defines a Retrofit API interface for a demo application, providing methods for login, token refresh, and accessing a protected resource, served by a mock backend interceptor.

classes.name: MockApiService
classes.description: Interface defining mock API endpoints for authentication and protected resource access.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends login request with credentials to obtain a token.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Requests a token refresh using the provided refresh token.

methods.name: protectedResource
methods.description: Accesses a protected resource that requires authentication.
